title: bahelia angustifolia
intro: Bahelia angustifolia, commonly known as Indian barberry, is a plant species belonging to the family Rutaceae. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of fever, digestive issues, and skin disorders, due to its antiseptic, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Bahelia angustifolia are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include limonoids, flavonoids, and coumarins. The bioactive constituents in this plant have been found to exhibit antioxidant, hepatoprotective, and anti-inflammatory activities, making it a potential source of natural remedies for various health conditions.
